Подбор берёт текущий выход изделия и пер: Fitting converts the current product yield to grams. Planned tiers, height, ledge, shape and average density determine tier dimensions. Yield, components and material cost stay unchanged. Example: 2000 g at 0.5 g/cm³ needs 4000 cm³. If the volume is too small for the ledges, reduce the ledge, height or tier count. This estimates dimensions, not structural safety.
Масса силуэта = сумма объёмов ярусов × с: Silhouette mass = total tier volume × average density. Round: π × (diameter / 2)² × height; square: side² × height. The button changes only product yield. Ingredient quantities and total cost stay unchanged, but cost per kg changes. To change usage, explicitly scale components rather than only replacing yield. A yield in ml requires finished-product density; a piece yield cannot be derived from mass.
Полная себестоимость = материалы + включ: Total cost = materials + enabled loss reserve + enabled extra costs. Labor, production and other amounts apply to the whole product. Clearing an amount means 0 and does not block other fields. Example: 245 + 10 = 255; clearing returns to 245. Negative values remain invalid. Unchecking excludes the cost without deleting its amount.
При себестоимости 100 и наценке 25% цена: At cost 100 and markup 25%, price is 125. At margin 25%, price is 100 / 0.75, rounded upward to 133.34. Minimum profit sets a price floor: cost + desired profit. The loss reserve applies only to materials; do not duplicate recipe losses. Changing currency does not convert amounts.
